plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for 6WIND VSR router. It reports uptime, CPU utilization, memory utilization, and interface traffic, for Virtual Service Router (enterprise PEN 2021).
name: Router

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.query: avg(device_cpu_usage{instance_type='router', __$labels__}) by (instance_id) or (100 - avg(device_cpu_idle{instance_type='router', __$labels__}) by (instance_id)) or (avg(device_cpu_user{instance_type='router', __$labels__}) by (instance_id) + avg(device_cpu_system{instance_type='router', __$labels__}) by (instance_id)) or avg(device_cpu_hr_usage{instance_type='router', __$labels__}) by (instance_id)
metrics.description: Overall CPU utilization of the 6WIND VSR router from UCD-SNMP ssCpuIdle (100 minus idle), falling back to ssCpuUser plus ssCpuSystem when idle is absent, then to HOST-RESOURCES hrProcessorLoad.

metrics.name: device_memory_total
metrics.description: Total real memory of the 6WIND VSR router (UCD-SNMP memTotalReal, reported in kB and converted to bytes), falling back to HOST-RESOURCES hrStorage physical-memory size.

metrics.name: device_memory_free
metrics.description: Available real memory of the 6WIND VSR router (UCD-SNMP memAvailReal, reported in kB and converted to bytes), falling back to HOST-RESOURCES hrStorage physical-memory free.

metrics.name: device_memory_used
metrics.description: Used real memory of the 6WIND VSR router, derived as memTotalReal minus memAvailReal and converted from kB to bytes, falling back to HOST-RESOURCES hrStorage physical-memory used.

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: Real memory utilization of the 6WIND VSR router, derived as (memTotalReal - memAvailReal) / memTotalReal * 100, falling back to HOST-RESOURCES hrStorage physical-memory used/size.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
